Our gardens / Old Town Courtyard

Courtyard gardens · Bath

Old Town Courtyard

A sheltered green retreat, designed around the character of old brick walls.

Location
Bath
Garden size
85 m²
Service
Design consultation
Concept year
2025

The starting point

An enclosed courtyard needed to feel welcoming without losing its quiet character. The brief called for a comfortable place to sit and planting that would cope with changing light.

The approach

The proposal keeps the central feature and treats the enclosing walls as part of the garden. A restrained material palette makes the small space feel coherent, with planting gathered at the edges to keep circulation clear.

Room to grow

Shade-tolerant ferns and evergreen shrubs carry the quieter corners. Climbers soften the brickwork, with careful attention to supports and access for maintenance.
